Day(1)

Heyy Janaa,
I hope ya rab that you are having fun with the people you love, with tia, w tala, and your dad and cousins and aunts and family.. It brings me so much joy to see you busy like that because I know that you are not thinking about everything going on when you are with the people you love, and when you are going out with them.. I want you to know that i'm here for you and that I miss you very much, I want you to know that I want you to come and talk to me about anything and everything, I hope that you are able to open up to me because I really care a lot..

But I know that you are always busy so for that slight chance that you are not able to come and talk to me when you are feeling down because its hectic around, I am going to be leaving you notes on here everyday, opening up to you and telling you how I feel about you, and tell you how amazing you are, and perfect in every single way, and to also tell you and remind you that everything is going to be okay princess :) things might be hard for a while but it wont stay that way forever.. I still dont know whats going on in that beautfiul mind of yours and eats me everyday, but what I do know for certain is that you are strong and capable with dealing through all these bad emotions and coming on top..

You should still know that you are not alone.. You should still know that you mean the entire world to me and that I care about you more than anyone or anything and that I actually mean that. You should know that no matter what happens i'll always be here to support you and take care of you because you are my responsibility.. Jana rabna kateb el 5air I want you to always remember that and believe that everything happens for a reason.. I promise you that it will be better soon.. I'm here okay? I really hope that you can come and talk to me about it soon.. Please eat well while you are in the uae and drink lots of water to stay hydrated w take care of yourself.. You are amazing Jana never forget that.. I love you <33

Day(2)

Heyyy Janaaa,

I missed you so much today and I was worried about you quite a lot because I really care about you so much and I really love you more than anything in the world.. I want to remind you that i'm here for you and that I always will be. I promise you to always do better than anyone would by your side, and be your #1 supporter. I want you to know that no matter what happens i'd never leave on you or judge you..

Because there isnt anything to judge in the first place.. You have such a beautiful and such a bright and perfect mind.. I'm in love with every single thought that goes on through that head of yours and I understand you and I love you for who you are.. I think that you are perfect in everyway.. you think that you are not normal like everyone with the germs overthinking or when you stress you are not normal.. but i'm telling you rn I love you for these things, I love these parts about you, I love every part about you, every detail, your personality, your looks, your thoughts, all of it, the entire package.. To me you are the normal one, actually not just "normal" but perfect in everyway and no one can ever compare to you <333

Day(3)

Heyyy Janaaa,
Today marks the 500 th day since we have.. Its been 500 days can you believe that? 500 days some good some bad, but even the bad ones with you were good.. We have been through so much together, and we always came out on top no matter what.. Its crazy to know how we met and how we got close and honestly its way too crazy to call that a coincidence.. I want you to know that you are the best thing that has ever happened to me and that I value you so so much more than you know.. in those 5oo days I have learned all about the person that to me is the love of my life...

Because you will always be the most person I love from the day we met and till the day I die.. You will always be my favourite person in the entire world now and forever.. You will always be the first thing on my mind when I wake up and the last thing I think of before falling alseep.. You might not believe that bas its the truth Jana wallah it is.. To me you are the most perfect girl in the entire world.. You are the so beautiful and gorgeous in everyway jad maleket jamal.. you make every other girl look ugly and unattractive.. You have the most attractive personality in the entire world and the most breathtaking smile.. your eyes tell a story not even the best of writers can..

You are my responsibiliy and you always will be no matter what okay? I promise to always be here to take care of you and give you the love that you need and the love and care that you deserve.. I promise to never change on you and that with everyday that passes my love for you will grow.. You deserve the world Jana I always want you to remember that and never think low of yourself or doubt yourself.. You are the strongest girl I have ever met, and I want you to know that I see everything you are going through and I understand.. w I genuienly am so proud of you, more proud than anyone could ever be.. Jana I want you to always come to me when you are feeling down..

Or if you feel like you need someone to talk to, because I promise you that i'll be a good listener for you and I promise to help you the best I could to put your feelings into words because ik how hard that is for you.. You are amazing Jana always remember that, and i'm the luckiest guy alive to have you in my life <333

(fun fact I used to know how to play the song for this note on the piano)

I love you so much Jana okay? alwyas remember that <333
